_leia: Frases das páginas da cathelier (início, lista de peças, ficha da peça), escritas por src/lib/cathelier.mjs. A origem é pt/; esta é a tradução inglesa. Cada frase leva o resumo (h) do português de onde saiu: quando o português mudar, o Worker refá-la. Uma corrigida à mão que não deva ser refeita leva "fixo": true.

foto.alt.t: {nome} — laser cut and engraved to order

inicio.quantidade.texto1.t: Wedding favours, christening keepsakes, place cards, corporate gifts, a season of trophies — anything here can be made in quantity, with a different name cut into every one.

inicio.quantidade.texto2.t: Tell us roughly what and roughly how many. There is no form to fight with: a message is enough, and we come back with a price and a date.

inicio.mais.texto.um.t: Cake toppers, signs, trophies, bookmarks, boxes, keyrings. {n} piece in all, and it takes a name.

inicio.mais.texto.varios.t: Cake toppers, signs, trophies, bookmarks, boxes, keyrings. {n} pieces in all, and every one of them takes a name.

lista.lede.um.t: {n} piece, made to order. It carries the names, the dates or the words you choose.

lista.lede.varios.t: {n} pieces, all made to order. Each one carries the names, the dates or the words you choose.

lista.porMedida.t: Something that is not here? We cut pieces to measure for weddings, christenings, parties, clubs and companies.

ficha.ajuda.t: Fill these in and we will send you a drawing to approve. Nothing is cut before you say yes.

ficha.garantia.desenho.t: A drawing to approve before anything is cut

ficha.garantia.mao.t: Cut, sanded and finished by hand

ficha.muitas.t: Ordering a lot of them? Ask for a quote and we will price the whole run.
